scale.means: Does not exist, or exists and is wrong
Exists somewhere, in someone’s head or inbox. Could not be produced this week
Exists and could be produced, but is incomplete, stale, or would need explaining
Exists, current, complete. Would survive a first look without comment
Exists, current, complete, and organised. Would survive a second look
A counterparty would remark on it. Rare, and you should not expect many

domains.name: Corporate and cap table
domains.question: Does this company legally exist in the shape you say it does, and will the shares actually be mine?

criteria.text: A fully diluted cap table exists, is current, and reconciles exactly to the statutory register and every instrument issued
Every financing instrument — equity, notes, SAFEs, warrants — is located, complete, signed, and modelled through a conversion waterfall
Every option or equity promise made to any person is documented and properly approved, with no undocumented commitments outstanding
Corporate records — constitutional documents, board minutes, resolutions, shareholder agreements and side letters — are complete and retrievable

domains.name: The financial record
domains.question: Are these numbers real, are they repeatable, and did this business produce them?

criteria.text: Monthly management accounts exist for at least twelve months, are produced within two weeks of month end, and reconcile to the statutory accounts
Revenue recognition is written down, consistently applied, and defensible under examination
A normalisation bridge exists — reported profit to underlying earnings — with every adjustment identified, quantified and evidenced by you
Forecast credibility is demonstrable: the last three forecasts are set against actuals, with variances explained

domains.name: Commercial and customers
domains.question: Where does the revenue come from, will it still be here next year, and does it depend on something fragile?

criteria.text: Revenue by customer is available for 24 months, with concentration quantified for top 1, 3 and 5 by revenue and gross profit, and the trend visible
Retention, churn and expansion are defined in writing, calculated consistently, and reproducible from source data
Every material customer contract is located and read, with term, notice, renewal and change-of-control provisions summarised
Unit economics are calculated from actual cost data rather than estimates, and the method is written down

domains.name: Contracts and legal
domains.question: What has this company committed to, what could come back, and does anything break on a change of ownership?

criteria.text: A contract register exists, listing every material agreement with counterparty, value, term, notice and renewal dates, and where the executed copy is
Change-of-control, exclusivity, minimum-commitment and guarantee provisions have been identified across the contract base and summarised in one place
All disputes, claims and settlements from the last three years are documented, including resolved ones, with current status
Licences, permits, insurance and property obligations are current, evidenced, and diarised for renewal

domains.name: IP, technology and data
domains.question: Do you actually own what you are selling, and is there anything in here that becomes my problem?

criteria.text: Signed IP assignments exist from every founder, employee and contractor who contributed to the product, with no known gaps
Trade marks, domains and registrations are held by the company rather than by individuals, and are current in the territories that matter
A dependency and open-source inventory exists, with licences identified and compatibility with your distribution model assessed
Access control, security posture and data-protection position are documented, with a current record of who can reach what

domains.name: People and key-person risk
domains.question: Does this company work without the people in this room, and will the ones who matter stay?

criteria.text: Every person working in the business has a current written agreement appropriate to how they actually work, with contractor arrangements reviewed for classification risk
Key-person dependencies are identified in writing, naming the specific knowledge, relationship or access each person uniquely holds
A functioning second layer exists: each critical function has someone other than the founder who can run it
Compensation is fully documented with no informal or verbal arrangements outstanding, and retention for key people has been considered

domains.name: The story and the model
domains.question: Does the narrative match the numbers, and do the numbers hold together when pulled?

criteria.text: Every figure in the deck traces to a source document, and the deck and the model agree on every shared number
The model is driver-based: growth emerges from stated assumptions about customers, pricing and retention rather than a hard-coded rate
Market sizing is built bottom-up from addressable customers and realistic pricing, with the top-down figure used only as a cross-check
The three assumptions the plan most depends on are stated explicitly, with what would have to be observed for each to be wrong

domains.name: The room itself
domains.question: How is this company actually run?

criteria.text: A numbered folder structure exists and is populated, with a consistent file-naming convention applied throughout
Every document in the room is current, with superseded versions removed and version control maintained
Access is staged by process stage and sensitivity, with a record of who has access and what they received
A question-and-answer log is maintained, so every answer given to any party is recorded and consistent
